purpose: Compile the selected distributional temporal-T2 predictor and the validated shadow-priced borrow/repay allocator for an opened-seed closed-loop engineering qualification without changing the full-copy action or environment.

evidence_boundary.runtime_refit_and_reference_role: deployment artifact construction, not new model-selection evidence

full_data_refit.numeric_adapter: parse or derive in the frozen order, quantize each finite numeric or missing NaN to binary32, then widen exactly to binary64
full_data_refit.heads: independent CONTROL and FULL_COPY_T2 six-class T-learners

runtime_outputs.deadline_rescue_reward: max(FULL_COPY_T2 CDF at 33333 us - CONTROL CDF at 33333 us, 0)
runtime_outputs.tail_acceleration_is_diagnostic_only: FULL_COPY_T2 CDF at 18000 us - CONTROL CDF at 18000 us

deployment_shadow_reference.role: fixed in-sample deployment reference for the already cross-fitted selected mechanism; never reported as independent performance evidence
deployment_shadow_reference.positive_reward_gate: deadline rescue reward strictly greater than zero
deployment_shadow_reference.congestion_signal: causal running mean of current primary PHY busy fraction over 20 ms
deployment_shadow_reference.training_group_state: mean signal through the exclusive end of each five-second bin
deployment_shadow_reference.congestion_cutpoints: one-third and two-thirds quantiles across all 96 opened run groups, separately for every time bin
deployment_shadow_reference.regime_assignment: numpy searchsorted with side right, yielding regimes 0, 1, or 2
deployment_shadow_reference.curve_pool: P-frame, positive-reward rows in groups assigned to the regime whose decision time is at or after the current bin start
deployment_shadow_reference.density: deadline rescue reward divided by the exact canonical P-frame reservation
deployment_shadow_reference.sort_order: density descending, then frame_id ascending, seed ascending, run_number ascending
deployment_shadow_reference.curve_resource: cumulative exact canonical reservation divided by the number of contributing run groups
deployment_shadow_reference.opportunity_cost: the marginal density at repayable_credit_us times contributing_run_count; infinity if none is affordable, zero if the complete curve is affordable

runtime_population_and_state.pairing: one primary path-1 copy-0 T2 endpoint immediately followed by its hypothetical untreated secondary path-0 copy-1 endpoint
runtime_population_and_state.history_ingestion: validate and retain both paired endpoints before policy gates so exact frame lags 1, 3, and 8 remain available
runtime_population_and_state.history_warmup: frames without all three exact lags cannot be scored
runtime_population_and_state.congestion_running_mean_updates: update on each in-window, history-ready, primary-actionable row before the P-frame and reward gates
runtime_population_and_state.primary_gate: primary copy remains actionable at T2
runtime_population_and_state.descriptor_gate: the canonical full-secondary-copy descriptor exists and matches immutable frame metadata

secondary_self_contamination_diagnostic.required_minimum_counter: number of scored decisions made while at least one earlier launched secondary reservation remains unsettled
secondary_self_contamination_diagnostic.interpretation: closed-loop regression relative to replay may indicate predictor feedback through passive secondary features

shadow_priced_borrow_repay.reservation_debit: debit the canonical reservation once, immediately after a successful full-copy launch
shadow_priced_borrow_repay.meter_role: separate measured-airtime evidence and settlement integrity; it never refunds allocator credit
shadow_priced_borrow_repay.balance_refill: before every decision, add only refill elapsed since the previous accounting time and cap positive balance at 360000 us
shadow_priced_borrow_repay.repayable_credit: current balance plus deterministic remaining refill
admission_order: reward density greater than or equal to the exported congestion-regime opportunity cost
canonical reservation no greater than repayable credit
sender accepts the requested full secondary copy
shadow_priced_borrow_repay.debt_limit: after every debit, balance must be at least negative remaining deterministic refill
shadow_priced_borrow_repay.repayment_requirement: after refill through measurement stop, every run balance must be nonnegative

required_exact_goldens: raw 308-feature vectors including finite, missing, and real-row fixtures
per-head imputed vectors and raw six logits
congestion cutpoints, regime assignment, opportunity cost, and boundary decisions
credit refill, debt, and final repayment

closed_loop_engineering_qualification.environment: unchanged canonical neutral environment used by the prior paired campaigns
closed_loop_engineering_qualification.primary_target: beat STR MLO on both all-generated-frame deadline-miss rate and completed-frame P99 latency
closed_loop_engineering_qualification.engineering_miss_target: approximately 0.50 percent or lower before fresh confirmation
required_allocator_diagnostics: gate, nonpositive-reward, opportunity-price, horizon-credit, launch-rejection, and action counts
action and canonical reservation by five-second bin and congestion regime
minimum balance, maximum debt, final balance, and repayment closure per run
decisions with an earlier unsettled secondary reservation
measured secondary airtime, reservation settlement, and sender-airtime reconciliation

interpretation_limits: The full-data refit and deployment shadow curves reuse all 96 opened model-development groups and cannot support an independent performance claim.
The cross-fitted replay excludes lag-8 startup and action-dirty secondary endpoints, while the closed-loop campaign evaluates all generated frames and policy feedback.

The 308-feature winner exceeded the primary-only HGB64 static frontier by only two captured primary misses; secondary-feature feedback is therefore a serious ablation risk, not evidence that secondary state is indispensable.
The offline replay does not identify completed-frame P99, sender airtime, contention feedback, or background throughput.
Borrowing deterministic future credit may create transient bursts even when every run repays by measurement stop.
EMLSR completed-frame P99 is not an optimization gate because its large miss population creates survivor bias; STR MLO is the engineering target.
